NAIROBI CITY COUNTY GOVERNMENT

The Nairobi City County Government invites applications from qualified persons for the following positions in the county public service.

VACANCY NO. NCCG/HR/45/2026: ASSISTANT WARD ADMINISTRATOR - JOB GROUP H

Number of Posts: Two (2)

Salary: KSh. 42,000 - 55,000 per month

Requirements for Appointment

For appointment to this grade, a candidate must have: (i) a Diploma in Public Administration or an equivalent qualification; (ii) a minimum of two (2) years of experience in county administration; (iii) proficiency in office software.

Duties and Responsibilities

Coordination of ward-level service delivery and maintenance of county records.

VACANCY NO. NCCG/HR/46/2026: DRIVER - JOB GROUP E

Number of Posts: Four (4)

Salary: KSh. 28,000 - 34,000 per month

Requirements for Appointment

For appointment to this grade, a candidate must have: (i) a valid class BCE driving licence; (ii) no prior work experience is required; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Duties and Responsibilities

Driving county vehicles and maintaining the vehicle log book.

Applications should be submitted to the County Public Service Board. The closing date for all applications is 28th November 2026.
